mainEntity.name: When should my business invest in FAQ content writing for AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Businesses should invest in FAQ content writing for AI SEO when they want to improve their online visibility, capture voice search queries, and answer common customer questions proactively. It's particularly beneficial if your audience frequently uses digital assistants or asks specific questions about your products/services. Early adoption helps establish authority and differentiate from competitors.
